name: Almost Heaven Salem 2-Person Barrel Sauna, 6x4 ft.
description: Almost Heaven Salem 2-Person Barrel Sauna The Salem 2-Person Barrel Sauna is designed for those with a long to-do list and an eye for efficiency. Built to accommodate two people, this 6’x4’ traditional barrel sauna will be at home in any backyard or home gym. Its compact design brings the sauna experience to your door without compromising space. Properly installed, the 6 kW heater in your Salem 2-Person Barrel Sauna Kit should consistently achieve temperatures of 180-200ºF in 45-60 minutes. Or, turn the dial to delay the start time up to eight hours, knock off your to-do list, and relax in the rewarding heat. WiFi control panels and heater upgrades are also available for an elevated sauna experience! Features Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8″ thick All glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED light Sauna stones included Weather-resistant plastic support cradles Two opposite-facing benches for sitting or reclining Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Limited lifetime warranty on the Salem sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Best-in-class electric heater and sauna stones Made in the USA Specifications Holds up to two people Standard heater (Harvia KIP60B): 6 kW, 240V, 30-amp requirement, hard-wire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled size: 72″W x 47″D x 77″H Interior Room size: 71″W x 39″D x 71″H Bench dimensions: 18″W x 39″L x 17″H Cradle dimensions 54" x 6" Shipping weight: 540 lbs Shipping size: 74″L x 41″W x 48″H Note: All dimensions are approximate. Options and Customizations Vista or Port rear window: Open the Salem barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the Vista or Port rear window. Door style: Outfit your Salem 2-Person Barrel Sauna with one of the following deluxe door options: full glass door, wood door with a window, or all-wood door. Care and Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping and Assembly The Salem sauna will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. The carrier will contact you to schedule a delivery date and time. Please see the shipping tab for more details. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. You should review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Why Select Saunas? We offer a wide range of options to enhance your sauna experience. Our saunas, including the Salem 2-Person Barrel Sauna, are backed by the original manufacturer's warranty, ensuring the highest standards of quality and performance. Plus, you'll enjoy the benefits of free shipping, hassle-free returns, a no-questions-asked satisfaction guarantee, and complimentary gifts with your order. Explore our collection today and find the perfect sauna to fit your lifestyle and space! Resources Almost Heaven Barrel Sauna Installation & Owner’s Manual Videos
